  · exact Or.inl hR
  right
  obtain ⟨K, TK, hK, hphi⟩ := exists_norm_quantizationTraceF_le_littlewood hW
  refine ⟨η * Real.exp (-4), K, mul_pos hη (Real.exp_pos _), hK, fun R => ?_⟩

  have hTR : R ≤ T := (le_max_left _ _).trans hT
  have hTK : TK ≤ T := (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hT)
  have hT2 : 2 ≤ T := (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hT)
  refine ⟨T, hTR, ?_⟩
  let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => canonicalPhase hW (2 * t) - lockConstant θ
  have hum : Measurable u :=
    ((measurable_canonicalPhase hW).comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)).sub_const _
  have hub : ∀ t, ‖u t‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro t
    simpa only [norm_canonicalPhase, norm_lockConstant, one_add_one_eq_two] using
      norm_sub_le (canonicalPhase hW (2 * t)) (lockConstant θ)
  have huI : IntegrableOn (fun t => ‖u t‖) (Ioc T (2 * T)) := by
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := 2) (by simp [Real.volume_Ioc])
      hum.norm.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    exact hub t
  let q : ℝ := K * Real.log T / Real.log (Real.log T)
  have hAE : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioc T (2 * T)),
      ‖lowerSourceRemainder hW (-θ) (-t)‖ ≤ (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) * ‖u t‖ := by
    apply (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr
    filter_upwards [norm_lowerSourceRemainder_phase_ae hW (-θ)] with t ht hmem
    rw [ht (by linarith [hmem.1]), inv_lockConstant_neg]
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hphi T hTK t hmem) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hrm := ((measurable_lowerSourceRemainder hW (-θ)).comp measurable_neg).norm
  have hrI : IntegrableOn (fun t => ‖lowerSourceRemainder hW (-θ) (-t)‖) (Ioc T (2 * T)) := by
    refine (huI.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q)).mono' hrm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hAE] with t ht
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using ht
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_ae_restrict hrI (huI.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q)) hAE
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hmono
  have hbad' : η * T ≤ (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) * ∫ t in Ioc T (2 * T), ‖u t‖ :=
    hbad.le.trans hmono
  have hcancel : Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp (-q) * (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
    rw [show (-4 : ℝ) + -q + (4 + q) = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]

  calc (η * Real.exp (-4)) * T * Real.exp (-q)
      = (Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp (-q)) * (η * T) := by ring
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp (-q)) *
        ((Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) * ∫ t in Ioc T (2 * T), ‖u t‖) := h

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  set μ := boundaryMeasure hW
  have hfib : ∀ ρ : XiDivisorSupport,
      (∑' i : Fin (xiDivisorMult ρ),
        ENNReal.ofReal (sharedCopyWeight hW ⟨ρ, i⟩) * g (ρ : ℂ).im) ≤
      if (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2 then μ {(ρ : ℂ).im} * g (ρ : ℂ).im else 0 := by
    intro ρ
    let q : XiZeroCopy := ⟨ρ, ⟨0, xiDivisorMult_pos ρ⟩⟩
    have hconst : ∀ i : Fin (xiDivisorMult ρ),
        sharedCopyWeight hW ⟨ρ, i⟩ = sharedCopyWeight hW q := fun _ => rfl
    rw [tsum_fintype]
    simp_rw [hconst]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hc : (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2
    · rw [if_pos hc, ← mul_assoc]
      have hm : (0 : ℝ) < xiDivisorMult ρ := by exact_mod_cast xiDivisorMult_pos ρ
      have hw := sharedCopyWeight_le_carried hW q
      have hmass : (xiDivisorMult ρ : ℝ) * sharedCopyWeight hW q ≤ (μ {(ρ : ℂ).im}).toReal := by
        change sharedCopyWeight hW q ≤
          (if (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2 then (μ {(ρ : ℂ).im}).toReal / xiDivisorMult ρ else 0) at hw
        rw [if_pos hc] at hw
        nlinarith [(le_div_iff₀ hm).mp hw]
      have hen : (xiDivisorMult ρ : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (sharedCopyWeight hW q) ≤
          μ {(ρ : ℂ).im} := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hmass).trans ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le
      exact mul_le_mul_left hen _
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      have hw : sharedCopyWeight hW q = 0 := by
        change 1 - (if (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2 then _ else 1) = 0
        rw [if_neg hc, sub_self]
      simp [hw]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_sigma']
  refine (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hfib).trans ?_
  have hsub : (∑' ρ : XiDivisorSupport,
      if (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2 then μ {(ρ : ℂ).im} * g (ρ : ℂ).im else 0) =
      ∑' ρ : CritPoint, μ {(ρ.1 : ℂ).im} * g (ρ.1 : ℂ).im := by
    set f : XiDivisorSupport → ℝ≥0∞ := fun ρ => μ {(ρ : ℂ).im} * g (ρ : ℂ).im
    have ht := tsum_subtype {ρ : XiDivisorSupport | (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2} f
    calc

          ∑' ρ, ({ρ : XiDivisorSupport | (ρ : ℂ).re = 1 / 2}).indicator f ρ := by
        apply tsum_congr

          f ρ := ht.symm

    rw [← Equiv.tsum_eq (Equiv.ofInjective _ critOrd_injective)]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro ρ
    simp [Equiv.ofInjective, mul_comm]
  rw [heq, ← lintegral_countable _ (Set.countable_range _)]
  exact setLIntegral_le_lintegral _ _

/-!
# The integer atomic floor of the canonical Weil measure

The floor of every actual singleton mass defines a dominated integer-valued atomic submeasure.
Its complement is a positive measure with every atom below one. Exact subtraction is proved on
finite-mass measurable sets by restricting before invoking finite measure cancellation. No
atomicity, discreteness, or total-mass assumption on the canonical source is supplied.
-/

open Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal Topology

namespace RHTower.WeilSpectral

/-- Integer part of the actual canonical singleton mass. -/
def quantizationIntegerWeight {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊(boundaryMeasure hW).real {r}⌋₊

/-- The canonical integer atomic floor, with no atomicity assumption on the source. -/
def quantizationIntegerMeasure {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : Measure ℝ :=
  Measure.sum fun r : ℝ => (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) • Measure.dirac r

/-- Positive residual measure after removal of the actual integer atomic floor. -/
def quantizationResidualMeasure {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : Measure ℝ :=
  boundaryMeasure hW - quantizationIntegerMeasure hW

theorem quantizationIntegerWeight_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) :
    (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ boundaryMeasure hW {r} := by
  calc
    (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((boundaryMeasure hW).real {r}) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Nat.floor_le ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    _ ≤ boundaryMeasure hW {r} := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW s =
      ∑' r : ℝ, ((s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW) r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure, Measure.sum_apply _ hs]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro r
  by_cases hr : r ∈ s <;> simp [Measure.smul_apply, hr]

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW ≤ boundaryMeasure hW := by
  classical
  refine Measure.le_iff.mpr fun s hs => ?_
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs, ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_sum]
  refine iSup_le fun F => ?_
  calc
    ∑ r ∈ F, ((s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW) r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
        ∑ r ∈ F, (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s {r} := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      by_cases hr : r ∈ s
      · simpa [Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_singleton r),
          singleton_inter_of_mem hr, hr] using quantizationIntegerWeight_le hW r
      · simp [hr, Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_singleton r),
          singleton_inter_of_notMem hr]
    _ = (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s (F : Set ℝ) := sum_measure_singleton
    _ ≤ (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s univ := measure_mono (subset_univ _)
    _ = boundaryMeasure hW s := by simp

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_singleton {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) :

  Measure.sum_smul_dirac_singleton

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_nat {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hfin : boundaryMeasure hW s ≠ ∞) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, quantizationIntegerMeasure hW s = n := by
  classical
  let f : ℝ → ℕ := s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW)
  have hf : ∑' r : ℝ, (f r : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := by
    rw [← quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs]
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfin (quantizationIntegerMeasure_le hW s)
  have hF : (Function.support f).Finite := by
    apply (ENNReal.finite_const_le_of_tsum_ne_top hf (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)).subset
    intro r hr
    change (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (f r : ℝ≥0∞)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hr

  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs]

  · intro r hr
    have hz : f r = 0 := by simpa using hr
    simp [hz]

theorem quantizationResidualMeasure_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationResidualMeasure hW ≤ boundaryMeasure hW := Measure.sub_le

    rw [gaussWeight_critical_eq, sourceTwoPointWeight_critical, Complex.re_mul_ofReal,

  simp only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, hp, integral_zero]

  rw [hfactor] at hi
